metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2002 · Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
metas.description: Ten years after initially meeting, Anakin Skywalker shares a forbidden romance with Padmé Amidala, while Obi-Wan Kenobi discovers a secret clone army crafted for the Jedi.

metas.name: ★ 5.4 · 2008 · Twilight
metas.description: When Bella Swan moves to a small town in the Pacific Northwest, she falls in love with Edward Cullen, a mysterious classmate who reveals himself to be a 108-year-old vampire.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2003 · Bruce Almighty
metas.description: A whiny news reporter is given the chance to step into God's shoes.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2005 · The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
metas.description: While playing, Lucy and her siblings find a wardrobe that lands them in a mystical place called Narnia. Here they realize that it was fated and they must now unite with Aslan to defeat an evil queen.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2005 · Constantine
metas.description: Detective Angela approaches Constantine, a demon hunter, to help her investigate her twin sister's mysterious death. As he digs deeper, he realizes that demons are trying to enter the human world.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2006 · Click
metas.description: A workaholic architect finds a universal remote that allows him to fast-forward and rewind to different parts of his life. Complications arise when the remote starts to overrule his choices.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2005 · Fantastic Four
metas.description: A group of astronauts gain superpowers after a cosmic radiation exposure and must use them to oppose the plans of their enemy, Doctor Victor Von Doom.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2004 · Hellboy
metas.description: A demon raised from infancy after being conjured by and rescued from the Nazis, grows up to become a defender against the forces of darkness.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2001 · The Mummy Returns
metas.description: The mummified body of Imhotep is shipped to a museum in London, where he once again wakes and begins his campaign of rage and terror.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2000 · How the Grinch Stole Christmas
metas.description: On the outskirts of Whoville lives a green, revenge-seeking Grinch who plans to ruin Christmas for all of the citizens of the town.

metas.name: ★ 4.8 · 2009 · The Twilight Saga: New Moon
metas.description: After Edward leaves because of an incident involving Bella, Jacob Black becomes her best friend, but what Bella doesn't realize is that Jacob also has a secret that will suddenly change their lives.
Author Michael Enslin, who specializes in debunking paranormal occurrences, checks into the fabled room 1408 in the Dolphin Hotel in New York City, settles in, and soon confronts genuine terror.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2001 · Vanilla Sky
metas.description: A self-indulgent and vain publishing magnate finds his privileged life upended after a vehicular accident with a resentful lover.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2004 · Van Helsing
metas.description: The famed monster hunter is sent to Transylvania to stop Count Dracula, who is using Dr. Frankenstein's research and a werewolf for nefarious purposes.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2003 · Underworld
metas.description: Selene, a vampire warrior, is entrenched in a conflict between vampires and werewolves, while falling in love with Michael, a human who is sought by werewolves for unknown reasons.

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2007 · Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
metas.description: The Fantastic Four learn that they aren't the only super-powered beings in the universe when they square off against the powerful Silver Surfer and the planet-eating Galactus.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2008 · Hellboy II: The Golden Army
metas.description: A prince of the mythical world starts a rebellion against humanity in order to rule the Earth. Hellboy and his team must fight to stop him from locating the all-powerful Golden Army.

metas.name: ★ 5.3 · 2007 · Ghost Rider
metas.description: A motorcycle stuntman who sold his soul becomes a supernatural agent of vengeance.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2004 · 13 Going on 30
metas.description: Unpopular schoolgirl Jenna Rink makes an unusual wish on her birthday. Miraculously, her wish comes true and the 13-year-old Jenna wakes up the next day as a 30-year-old woman.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2000 · What Women Want
metas.description: A cocky, chauvinistic advertising executive magically acquires the ability to hear what women are thinking.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2009 · 17 Again
metas.description: Mike O'Donnell is ungrateful for how his life turned out. He gets a chance to rewrite his life when he tried to save a janitor near a bridge and jumped after him into a time vortex.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2001 · Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
metas.description: Adventurer Lara Croft explores lost empires and discovers immeasurable treasures in her daily life, but a secret from the past of her father, a missing archaeologist, will lead her to one of her greatest challenges.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2006 · Underworld: Evolution
metas.description: Picking up directly from the previous movie, vampire warrior Selene and the half werewolf Michael hunt for clues to reveal the history of their races and the war between them.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2007 · The Golden Compass
metas.description: In a parallel universe, young Lyra Belacqua journeys to the far North to save her best friend and other kidnapped children from terrible experiments by a mysterious organization.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2009 · The Lovely Bones
metas.description: Centers on a young girl who has been murdered and watches over her family - and her killer - from purgatory. She must weigh her desire for vengeance against her desire for her family to heal.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2003 · The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen
metas.description: In an alternate Victorian Age world, a group of famous contemporary fantasy, science fiction, and adventure characters team up on a secret mission.

metas.name: ★ 5.3 · 2008 · The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
metas.description: In the Far East, Alex O'Connell, the son of famed mummy fighters Rick and Evy O'Connell, unearths the mummy of the first Emperor of Qin -- a shape-shifting entity cursed by a witch centuries ago.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2003 · Freaky Friday
metas.description: Dr. Tess Coleman and her daughter, Anna, do not get along with each other. However, things take a turn when, in a freak accident, they switch bodies and are forced to live each other's lives.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2009 · Underworld: Rise of the Lycans
metas.description: A prequel centered on the origins of the centuries-old feud between the race of aristocratic vampires and their former slaves, the Lycans.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2006 · The Lake House
metas.description: A lonely doctor who once occupied an unusual lakeside house begins to exchange love letters with its former resident, a frustrated architect. They must try to unravel the mystery behind their extraordinary romance before it's too ...

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2007 · Evan Almighty
metas.description: God contacts Congressman Evan Baxter and tells him to build an ark in preparation for a great flood.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2009 · The Invention of Lying
metas.description: A comedy set in a world where no one has ever lied, until a writer seizes the opportunity for personal gain.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2009 · The Imaginarium of Doctor Parnassus
metas.description: Having made a deal with the Devil himself for immortality many millennia ago, the now decrepit mystic Doctor Parnassus fights for the freedom of his only daughter's soul.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2001 · Shallow Hal
metas.description: A superficial man now sees only the inner beauty of a very fat woman.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2002 · Reign of Fire
metas.description: A brood of fire-breathing dragons emerges from the earth and begins setting everything ablaze, establishing dominance over the planet.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2002 · The Scorpion King
metas.description: A desert warrior rises up against the evil army that is destroying his homeland. He captures the enemy's key sorcerer, takes her deep into the desert and prepares for a final showdown.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2009 · Triangle
metas.description: Five friends set sail and their yacht is overturned by a strange and sudden storm. A mysterious ship arrives to rescue them, and what happens next cannot be explained.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2003 · Lara Croft: Tomb Raider - The Cradle of Life
metas.description: A globe-trotter must find Pandora's box before a maniacal scientist can harness its power for world domination.
